series_identification.ez_series_kind: ez_hicp monthly (Euro area 19 HICP all-items index, FRED/OECD MEI-derived)
series_identification.audit_finding: NG4-A7-F1 (HIGH): the p0b A4 FAIL was an artifact of the as-of snapshot ingest shape, not a feed property
series_identification.prescription: a7_terminal_ng4.json required_owner_action: one wide-window ALFRED pull (realtime_start <= 2015-02-27 .. 9999-12-31), parse to VintageRows (true windows), feed UNMODIFIED to rs.build_restricted_stream, let the frozen floors decide

query_shape.law: A7-F1 prescription (a7_terminal_ng4.json required_owner_action): ONE wide-window ALFRED pull with realtime_start <= the committed V8 earliest-vintage bound 2015-02-27 and realtime_end 9999-12-31, same existing entitlement, limit/offset paging of the SAME shape only while a full page returns

key_check.key_source: gitignored root .env, loaded programmatically; the value is never echoed into any output, log, artifact or commit

pull.raw_bytes_policy: UNTRACKED_NEVER_COMMITTED (data_raw/forex_ng4_ez/wide_window.json + wide_window_pages/); the committed manifest pins every file by sha256, verify-on-read

streams.realtime_era_law: ng2 frozen law, UNMODIFIED, on true-window rows: era start = min realtime_start over the archive rows; obs months >= era start are first-print era, earlier months are backfill history (the archive's own clock zero, not a snapshot-day artifact)

open_version_stat.law: ALFRED convention: each obs month's final still-in-force version carries realtime_end 9999-12-31 (recorded as a measured identity, never a gate)

streams.restricted_definition: first-print restricted event = ng2 revision event (v1->v2 index gap with full realtime windows, strict monotonicity fail-closed), usable in the S0 window, with first_print_in_realtime_era=True AND not a member of any bulk re-referencing group (>= 10 events sharing an identical (v1 day, v2 day, ratio-to-1e-6) signature)

differential.join_key_law: obs month key (ng2): a differential month requires an EZ restricted event AND a US restricted event in the same obs month

a4_ez_print_events.law: EZ print events (ng2/ng3 restricted first-print standard: v1->v2 version gap, full availability windows, S0-usable, first-print era, non-bulk) on the wide-window TRUE-vintage archive rows

a5_ez_us_differential_months.law: obs months carrying BOTH an EZ restricted event and a US restricted event (US leg: pinned CADS CPIAUCSL realtime archive, ng3 restricted standard)

q6_ez_recent_measured.law: Q-6 law on the EZ restricted stream (last 24 calendar months of S0, matched on v2 availability days); measured and disclosed -- NO floor was ever frozen for the EZ recent window (the ng3 >= 15 floor was CA-specific), so no verdict is inferred

checks: every row parses under the ng1 realtime parser
canaries.law: wide_pull.validate_wide_response executed on the merged document (fail-closed: any violation raises and NOTHING is measured)
ng2 vintages_by_month STRICT realtime-monotonicity law executed on the true-window rows inside build_restricted_stream (a violation raises VintageMonotonicityError and NOTHING is built)

load_pinned_wide re-hashed every pinned page AND the merged document against the committed manifest sha256s, re-merged the pages and required byte-equality with the pinned merged document, then re-ran the full wide-response canaries before any row entered the machinery

us_side_context.series: CPIAUCSL (US/fred_cpiaucsl_rt.json, pinned via CADS 7f18ec98..., verify-on-read address == sha256 of bytes)
us_side_context.law: ng2/ng3 restricted first-print standard on pinned bytes; measured as the US leg of the A5 EZ-vs-US differential

era_comparison_p0b_vs_p0c.law: A7-F1 reconciliation, artifact-vs-artifact: the SAME frozen ng2/ng3 machinery on the SAME feed under two query shapes; era_start (min realtime_start over rows) is a function of the shape, not the feed

as_of_snapshot_basis_p0b.basis: monthly ALFRED as-of snapshots 2017-12-01..2025-12-01; every row's realtime window CLAMPED to the query day (reconstructed panel)

wide_window_basis_p0c.basis: ONE wide-window ALFRED pull realtime 2015-01-01..9999-12-31; TRUE vintage windows (one row per value version, the V8 archive shape)

no_outcome_law: NO PnL, NO outcome, NO scoring in this census
